rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with John's operational leadership in cloud-native and AI infrastructure — Charlie needs builders equipped with modern tooling, and John's experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure combined with his community leadership at Code and Coffee positions him to help scale developer access to these platforms. Both are deeply invested in developer communities and tools (Charlie from Quora/Expo, John from Code and Coffee), making this a natural conversation around how infrastructure and platforms can democratize software development in the AI era.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet John Komarnicki — you're both convinced AI is opening software development to new builders, and John's background in cloud infrastructure and developer communities could offer valuable perspective on what Expo needs to support the next wave of creators.
